message:
Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The fuzz harness enables PROXY protocol parsing unconditionally."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"Inputs beginning with the PROXY signature are dispatched to the proxy parser before HTTP handling."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":158,"var":"end","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size); if (!end || end[1] != '\\n') return NULL;","note":"The v1 parser only accepts a bounded CRLF-terminated line, so a valid exploit needs a well-formed proxy line."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":171,"var":"protocol","code":"protocol = buffer + sizeof(\"PROXY \") - 1; src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); dst_addr = strsep_char(src_addr, ' ');","note":"The parser rewrites the attacker buffer in place while splitting the fields, making its state depend on the exact field layout."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":179,"var":"dst_port","code":"if (UNLIKELY(!dst_port)) return NULL;","note":"The header is rejected unless all four fields are present, so the candidate must provide syntactically complete address and port data."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":194,"var":"request->flags","code":"request->flags |= REQUEST_PROXIED;","note":"On success, the request is marked proxied and the parser advances past the header, changing how later request processing interprets the buffer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1176,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"HTTP parsing resumes from the bytes after the proxy header, so any malformed length or layout bug in the prefix would misalign the rest of the request."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
